content: In this paper, we propose a method that builds upon BERT's architecture. We split the input text sequence into shorter segments in order to obtain a representation for each of them using BERT. Then, we use either a recurrent LSTM BIBREF10 network, or another Transformer, to perform the actual classification. We call these techniques Recurrence over BERT (RoBERT) and Transformer over BERT (ToBERT). Given that these models introduce a hierarchy of representations (segment-wise and document-wise), we refer to them as Hierarchical Transformers. To the best of our knowledge, no attempt has been done before to use the Transformer architecture for classification of such long sequences.
